The image shows vertical striations (likely granite or metamorphic), not horizontal strata. While the Router marked this 'false', it is a significant deviation from the 'typical' cliff description provided in the taxonomy, though geologically valid for other rock types. I agree with the 'false' verdict but note that this reduces the 'typicality' of the generation. The 'Talus deposits' checkpoint was correctly marked untestable due to occlusion. This is a moderate texture anomaly (severity ~2.5). The foreground vegetation exhibits generative smoothing/blur (severity ~1.5). The sky-rock boundary has a slight fade/melt (severity ~1.0). The Perceptual Quality Auditor underestimated the texture issue, focusing on noise rather than detail synthesis. The combination of waxy textures and soft boundaries indicates a clear AI-generated origin with moderate quality defects.
